implementation.workflowContract: A labeled search.many batch supplies Path, PatternId, MatchIndex, LineNumber, Utf16Column, Utf16Length and MatchText. The recipe relates only same-file right spans inside inclusive line and same-line gap bounds.
implementation.cardinalityContract: All-pairs mode emits every eligible repeated right occurrence but fails when MaxPairsPerLeft is exceeded; nearest-right mode emits the first deterministic candidate only. Neither mode silently truncates output.

gateResults.evidence: The exact Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,621 total tests, 1,587 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the new proximity tests and Search suite also passed.
The separate review approved the ordering, same-file, window, cardinality and semantic boundaries; tested source hashes, exact commands and the review artifact are retained.

The proximity fixture independently asserts the exact six eligible same-file pairs, same-line gaps, line-distance bounds, nearest selection, absent partners and fail-fast cap; the registered semantic harnesses also passed.
The documented search.many projection compiles and runs against the proximity fixture, and the versioned recipe describes the supported row fields, ordering and lexical-only boundary.

knownLimitations: The relation is lexical proximity only and does not prove language structure, symbol identity, control flow or runtime behavior.
All-pairs mode fails closed when MaxPairsPerLeft is exceeded; it does not produce a partial result with an implicit truncation claim.
Same-line gaps use UTF-16 coordinates and do not infer byte offsets from those coordinates.
